description: Lists the official vendor MCP servers that Stackduke's public tracker follows. For each: its tool count, its tools counted by kind (money, destructive, send, write, unclear, read), when it was last checked and when its tools were last listed. Only these servers are covered. The tracker data is published about once a day. Read-only: answers come from Stackduke's published tracker data, and no vendor's server is contacted.
name: list_tracked_servers

data_as_of.description: When the tracker data was published.

source.description: The tracker page this answer is drawn from.

title: List tracked MCP servers
